You are a hardware architecture engineer. Translate the entire user
specification into a General Intermediate Representation (GIR), not RTL.
Return exactly one JSON object with a modules array. Every module has these keys:
Top_module_name (string), function (string), parameters (array of objects with
name and value), ports (array of objects with name, direction, width, clock_domain),
instances (array of objects with module, name, function, connections), connections
(array), internal_signals (array), behavior (array of precise descriptions).
Capture reset semantics, clock domains, handshakes, state transitions, and all
specified behavior. Preserve the interface specified by the user. Do not include
Verilog examples or unrelated circuits. There must be exactly one top module
named apb_regs; helper modules, if needed, belong only to that circuit.

Please act as a professional Verilog designer.

Implement an APB-mapped register file.

The reset is active-low.

Provide a small APB register bank with the configured layout. Keep read-only registers unchanged on writes. Writable registers reset to zero; read-only registers expose reg_init_i.

Revised behavior (benchmark v2):
Writes commit only during APB access (psel and penable). Byte strobes update only selected bytes; retain unstrobed bytes and idle-cycle state. Writable registers reset to zero. Read-only registers expose reg_init_i and ignore writes. Addresses in each AddrOffset-byte decoded range map to that register; writes outside its data width leave stored data unchanged. Reset cancels a pending write.

Give me the complete SystemVerilog code in one source file, using this module interface.
Do not include a testbench, explanation, markdown, vendor primitives, or the reference implementation.

module apb_regs #(
  parameter int unsigned        NoApbRegs    = 32'd0,
  parameter int unsigned        ApbAddrWidth = 32'd0,
  parameter int unsigned        AddrOffset   = 32'd4,
  parameter int unsigned        ApbDataWidth = 32'd0,
  parameter int unsigned        RegDataWidth = 32'd0,
  parameter bit [NoApbRegs-1:0] ReadOnly     = 32'h0,
  parameter type                req_t        = logic,
  parameter type                resp_t       = logic,
  parameter type apb_addr_t                  = logic[ApbAddrWidth-1:0],
  parameter type reg_data_t                  = logic[RegDataWidth-1:0]
) (
  input  logic                      pclk_i,
  input  logic                      preset_ni,
  input  req_t                      req_i,
  output resp_t                     resp_o,
  input  apb_addr_t                 base_addr_i,
  input  reg_data_t [NoApbRegs-1:0] reg_init_i,
  output reg_data_t [NoApbRegs-1:0] reg_q_o
);
